action.name: Balanced to Custom with saved component levels

validation.applyResult: Confirmed: Synapse selected Custom and emitted paired 0D/02 Custom/Automatic writes followed by 0D/07 CPU 02 and GPU 00 writes. A later controlled CPU matrix established that raw CPU 02 means High, correcting the original visual correlation.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed: independent exact-device 0D/82 queries returned Custom/Automatic and 0D/87 returned CPU 02 and GPU 00. The CPU byte is protocol readback, but the original visible Medium label was miscorrelated; the later matrix is authoritative.
validation.restorationResult: Confirmed visually and by typed readback: the final profile was restored to Balanced/Automatic with saved CPU 02 and GPU 00. This does not establish CPU 02 as Medium.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed: exact-device 0D/82 returned both Balanced/Automatic channel values after capture ended.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Custom/Automatic selected on both thermal channels.
Synapse reapplied the saved component levels when Custom was selected.
GPU Low, Medium, and High were independently captured and read back; a clean High-to-Low restoration was also captured.
0D/87 mapped visible GPU Low, Medium, and High to 00, 01, and 02. The original CPU 02-to-Medium correlation was later disproven by a controlled matrix: CPU Low, Medium, and High are 00, 01, and 02.

The CPU Medium-to-Low click produced no transaction because CPU preset controls were disabled while CPU Voltage Optimizer was enabled. Three timeout-bound sessions ended before their delayed clicks and contain no setting transaction.

productionAdmission.identityScope: RZ09-0528, BIOS 2.02, USB 1532:02C6, HID usage 0001:0002, 91-byte feature reports

limitations: This partial capture alone does not production-admit Custom; see the later AC custom CPU matrix for the complete CPU Low, Medium, and High evidence.
The original visible CPU correlation in this session was corrected: PID 02C6 CPU Low, Medium, and High map to 00, 01, and 02.
CPU Voltage Optimizer and GPU Overclock were not changed during this partial session.
Raw PCAPs and unique device identifiers remain private and uncommitted.
notes: Final visible and typed state was Plugged In, Balanced, Auto (Default), with saved CPU 02 and GPU 00.
Keyboard lighting remained off at the operator's request.
